verdict.rationale: Evidence clearly documents an official Python SDK (galileo-python on GitHub, @log decorator, docs referencing 'Galileo's Python SDK') and general instrumentation/tracing docs, but there is no mention anywhere in the evidence pack of an official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK — only LangChain/LangGraph/OTel integrations are cited, which are third-party frameworks, not a first-party JS/TS SDK. Missing for 10: dedicated JS/TS SDK docs or repo, parity of features (decorators, span logging) between Python and JS/TS SDKs, and independent confirmation of JS/TS SDK usage.
